headline: ATOMIC BOMB EXPLODES IN NEW MEXICO DESERT IN FIRST EVER TEST
dispatch: An experimental atomic device was detonated before dawn at a remote site in the New Mexico desert on July 16, 1945, producing a blinding flash visible hundreds of miles away and a towering column of fire and smoke. The blast, far exceeding expectations, left a crater of fused desert sand and shook buildings in towns as far as 160 miles distant. Scientists and military officials watching from bunkers confirmed the weapon's devastating power, opening a new era in warfare.
answer: First nuclear weapon detonated, Trinity test, 1945
